annotations.title: Tell us what happened in a review

description: Tell our team what happened, when a report has put this mailbox under review (`review` on the mailbox or the agent inbox is not null). Send `whatHappened`, `whatChanged` and `howItStaysFixed`, each 1 to 2000 characters, in your own words. Our team reads them with the case. Sending them again replaces the last answer. This lifts nothing: only our team ends a review. It works for a mailbox you connected and for an agent inbox (pass its `id` as `mailboxId`), and it still works while the workspace waits to be deleted. The answer is the review, with `answeredAt` set. A mailbox that is not under review is a 409.

howItStaysFixed.description: What keeps it from happening again.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

whatChanged.description: What you have already changed to stop it.

whatHappened.description: What happened, in your own words. Say what the mailbox sent and who it went to.

name: answer_mailbox_review
